summary: Hafnia Limited, a Singapore-domiciled shipping company dual-listed on the NYSE (HAFN) and Oslo Børs (HAFNI), filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of ordinary shares to non-affiliate investors. No price, share count, or total deal size is stated; the September 22, 2026 reference prices were $9.71 on the NYSE and NOK 94.70 in Oslo. Fearnley, Pareto, Clarksons, and Arctic act as placement agents with no firm commitment, earning a 2.50% cash fee plus a tiered 0.75%-1.00% incentive fee. Watch pricing, discount, and share-lending overhang.
